title: 第4章 投喂霍雨浩，黏人的王冬儿
slug: 斗罗冬儿重生我不是唐舞桐
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

王冬儿仰着头看霍雨浩，看到他额角的细汗，看到他那双眼睛里难得亮起来的光。

霍雨浩正准备再问一句“服不服”，却忽然发现身下的人安静得过分。

刚才还凶得像只小豹子似的王冬儿，此刻正安安静静地躺着，那双漂亮的粉蓝色眼睛直直地看着他。

然后她笑了一下，嘴角弯弯的，眉眼弯弯的。

“服了，雨浩好厉害。”

霍雨浩愣住了。

这个语气，这个眼神，这句话，都和他预想中的反应完全不同。

就在他愣神的这一瞬，一种清甜的香气忽然钻进了他的鼻腔。

不是花香，不是香囊的味道，是王冬儿身上自带的淡淡香气。

若有若无，像是有一根羽毛轻轻挠了一下他的心脏。

霍雨浩这才意识到，他把人家压在身下，而王冬儿的脸就在他眼前不到半尺的距离。

太近了。

霍雨浩的脸腾地红了。

不是普通的红，是从脖子一路烧到耳尖的红。

他的大脑一片空白，那缕若有若无的香气还在鼻尖盘旋，搅得他什么都想不起来了。

他像被烫了手一样弹了起来，连连后退，后背撞上墙壁，发出一声闷响。

“你、你。”

他半天没说出一句完整的话。

王冬儿从地上站起来，拍了拍身上的灰尘。

“地上打扫得还不够干净啊。”

她抬眼看向靠在墙边满脸通红的霍雨浩，轻轻笑了一声。

霍雨浩不明白，自己的心为什么会跳得这么快，像是找到了失去已久的东西。

王冬儿没有管霍雨浩在想什么，她把自己的床铺好，带来的行李也全都放好。

霍雨浩觉得自己应该做点什么，又把房间打扫了一遍。

“我肚子饿了，你要去吃点东西吗？”

霍雨浩摇摇头。

“走嘛，一起去。”

王冬儿挽着霍雨浩的手臂，把他拉出去。

霍雨浩震惊的看着王冬儿，这么自来熟的吗？

他低头看着那只挽在自己臂弯里的手，手指白皙修长，指甲修剪得干干净净。他的动作自然得好像已经做过了无数遍。

王冬儿拽着霍雨浩就往外走。

走廊里有几个路过的学员，看见两个男生手挽手走出来，目光微妙地停顿了一下。

霍雨浩注意到了那些目光，脸一下子又红了，赶紧把手抽了出来。往旁边退了半步，拉开距离。

王冬儿看了他一眼，嘴角弯了弯，没说什么。

从宿舍楼到食堂的路不算长。

王冬儿走得很慢。

她的目光扫过路边每一棵树，每一块微微翘起的石板。这些在别人眼里普普通通的景物，对她来说都是失而复得的珍宝。

前世她也走过这条路，和霍雨浩一起。那时候她脚步轻快，根本不会多看路边一眼。

她觉得这样的日子会永远过下去，修炼、吃饭、和霍雨浩拌嘴、学习。她以为明天永远会有明天。

直到一切都被夺走，她才明白，这些所谓的不值钱的日常，才是最珍贵的东西。

食堂里人没有太多，空气里混杂着红烧肉的酱香，还有烤饼出炉时那种焦焦的面香。

王冬儿一进门就直奔窗口，点了一大堆食物。

Wang Donger looked up at Huo Yuhao, saw the fine sweat on his forehead, and saw the rare light in his eyes.

Huo Yuhao was about to ask "Do you agree?" when he suddenly realized that the person under him was too quiet.

Wang Donger, who was as fierce as a little leopard just now, was lying quietly at the moment, looking straight at him with her beautiful pink-blue eyes.

Then she smiled, with curved corners of her mouth and curved eyebrows.

"I'm convinced, Yuhao is so awesome."

Huo Yuhao was stunned.

This tone, this look, these words were completely different from the reaction he expected.

At this moment when he was stunned, a sweet fragrance suddenly entered his nose.

It's not the scent of flowers or sachets, it's the faint scent of Wang Donger's body.

If there was nothing, it was like a feather gently tickling his heart.

Only then did Huo Yuhao realize that he was holding her down, and Wang Donger's face was less than half a foot away from him.

Too close.

Huo Yuhao's face turned red.

It's not an ordinary red, it's a burning red from the neck to the tips of the ears.

His mind went blank, and the faint scent was still lingering on the tip of his nose, making him unable to think of anything.

He jumped up as if his hand had been scalded, retreated repeatedly, and his back hit the wall with a muffled sound.

"You, you."

He didn't say a complete sentence for a long time.

Wang Donger stood up from the ground and dusted himself off.

"The floor is not clean enough."

She raised her eyes to look at Huo Yuhao, who was leaning against the wall with a red face, and smiled softly.

Huo Yuhao didn't understand why his heart was beating so fast, as if he had found something he had lost for a long time.

Wang Donger didn't care what Huo Yuhao was thinking. She made her bed and put away all the luggage she brought.

Huo Yuhao felt that he should do something and cleaned the room again.

"I'm hungry, do you want to go get something to eat?"

Huo Yuhao shook his head.

"Let's go, let's go together."

Wang Donger took Huo Yuhao's arm and pulled him out.

Huo Yuhao looked at Wang Donger in shock. Is he so familiar?

He looked down at the hand in his arm. The fingers were white and slender, and the nails were neatly manicured.His movements were so natural that he seemed to have done them countless times.

Wang Donger dragged Huo Yuhao and walked out.

There were several students passing by in the corridor. When they saw two boys walking out hand in hand, their eyes paused subtly.

Huo Yuhao noticed those glances, his face suddenly turned red again, and he quickly pulled his hand out.He took a half step back to the side and distanced himself.

Wang Donger glanced at him, curved the corners of her mouth, and said nothing.

The walk from the dormitory building to the cafeteria is not long.

Wang Donger walked very slowly.

Her eyes scanned every tree and every slightly raised stone slab on the roadside.These ordinary scenery in the eyes of others are all lost and found treasures to her.

She also walked this road in her previous life, together with Huo Yuhao.At that time, she was so light-footed that she didn't even look at the roadside.

She felt that such a life would last forever, practicing, eating, bickering with Huo Yuhao, and studying.She thought there would always be tomorrow.

It wasn't until everything was taken away that she realized that these so-called worthless everyday things were the most precious things.

There were not many people in the cafeteria, and the air was mixed with the aroma of braised pork and the smell of burnt noodles when scones come out of the oven.

As soon as Wang Donger entered the door, she went straight to the window and ordered a lot of food.
